title: Test-takers have a say: understanding the implications of the use of AI in language tests

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative interviews and online surveys gathering anecdotal evidence of automated scoring systems penalizing test-takers with high-pitched female voices.

Qualitative interviews and online surveys capturing test-takers' experiences of automated AI models and human graders unfairly scoring individuals with strong non-native accents (e.g., Spanish accents).
Qualitative interviews and online surveys documenting test-taker concerns that automated scoring systems trained on imbalanced datasets may skew fairness and performance across diverse ethnic groups.
